title: The Real Reason You Automatically Smile Back
hook: You automatically smile back at people, even when you do not mean to.

narration.text: You automatically smile back at people, even when you do not mean to.
This is often called a mirror reflex, and it is a natural human behaviour.
Special brain cells, called mirror neurons, are responsible for this.
They activate both when you perform an action and when you observe someone else doing it.
This reflex helps us understand others' emotions and intentions, building empathy.
It is why emotions can seem contagious, spreading from person to person.
Next time, try to notice yourself doing it, you will see it everywhere.
Tell us in the comments if you notice this happening to you. Like this if it surprised you, and subscribe for more insights into your mind.

description: Have you ever wondered why you automatically smile back at someone? It is a fascinating mirror reflex driven by special neurons in your brain. This video explains the science behind it.
topic: Why you might automatically smile when someone smiles at you. This is a mirror reflex.
